scripts.build:apk: cd mobile && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:package: npm run build:frontend && rm -rf src/jotter/dist build && cp -r frontend/dist src/jotter/dist && pyproject-build
scripts.test:mobile: cd packages/vault-format && npm test && cd ../../mobile && npm test
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:mobile
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix && npm run lint:mobile:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:mobile
scripts.format:check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run format:frontend:check && npm run format:mobile:check
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../packages/vault-format && npm install && cd ../../mobile && npm install && cd .. && pip install -e .[dev]
